newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania holds Frenchman after alleged child sex abuse.
newsitem.headline: Romania holds Frenchman after alleged child sex abuse.

text.p: A French citizen has been arrested after being filmed having sex with two Romanian underage boys, police said on Friday.
It was the second arrest of a foreigner in Romania this month for alleged sexual abuse of children.
National police spokesman Harlambie Neda identified the suspect as a 44-year-old lawyer from near Paris.
"Now in police custody (he) was caught late on Thursday in a flat near the city's main railway station having sex with two boys aged 12 and 15," Neda said by telephone.

The man, who has not yet been formally charged, had entered Romania last month as a tourist and had been "active for two years" in the country. He had confessed to having sex with 50 of 200 boys he had befriended during various visits.

A private Romanian television station showed footage on Thursday of what it alleged was a French-speaking man in his underclothes in bed with two boys. It said he had been undergoing psychiatric treatment in France.
If convicted, the Frenchman faces jail sentence of up to seven years under a recently adopted criminal code.
A German citizen was charged earlier this month with sexual offences involving underage boys in western Romania.
Pornography and child prostitution have become rampant in Romania since the December 1989 anti-communist revolt and execution of Stalinist dictator Nicolae Ceausescu ended strict social controls.
Hundreds of children from poor backgrounds leave their homes to live in squalor on Bucharest streets and are easy prey for well-organised paedophiles from Western countries.
The charity Save the Children says some 50 paedophiles from Germany, France and Britain travel regularly to Romania.
